labels.value: Gospel of Mark (LIT2711Mark) — Geʽez research transcription; canon link unresolved

tradition_assertions.notes: The TEI identifies a Mark work and declares Geʽez for its text edition, but the exact Church-list work/edition crosswalk, completeness, and relation to a current EOTC edition are unresolved. This is a related research transcription, not a canon-linked reader.

witness.title: Beta maṣāḥǝft TEI record LIT2711Mark, captured 2026-10-25
witness.date_statement: Local snapshot captured 2026-10-25; exact printed exemplar not identified
witness.editorial_policy: The source TEI is retained unchanged. The reader flattens inline markup and normalizes whitespace; chapter labels, line order, source n labels when present, and source references are preserved in the extracted data. Unnumbered line elements are not assigned verse labels.

coverage.structure_description: The retained TEI snapshot contains 16 ordered chapter divisions and 765 line elements: 678 have source n labels and 87 do not. This counts elements in the snapshot; the completeness of the intended printed work is unknown.
coverage.supplements_and_editorial_signs: The flattened reader preserves source line markers, inline reference targets, and an archive display order separately. It does not interpret unnumbered lines or reconstruct omitted wording; consult the unchanged source TEI for inline markup.
coverage.numbering_policy: Retain each source n label exactly when present. Do not assign source verse numbers to the 87 unnumbered line elements; display sequence numbers are navigation indexes only.

rights.statement: The item-level TEI file explicitly states CC BY-SA 4.0. This reader is an adaptation that flattens inline TEI markup and normalizes whitespace; attribute Beta maṣāḥǝft and the file credits, indicate changes, link https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/, and distribute adaptations under the same terms. The separate website footer license does not replace the source-file license.
rights.territory_or_term_limits: The file-level license applies to the cited TEI file and its adaptations, not every Mark edition or the whole website.
